title: Recommendation Schema
description: Forge's evidence-backed expert evaluation for a technology, encapsulating strengths, weaknesses, trade-offs, suitability for specific workloads, and the underlying supporting citations.

recommendation_score.title: Recommendation Score
recommendation_score.description: Overall score representing Forge's recommendation level for this technology, from 0 to 10.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Level of confidence in this recommendation, from 0 (lowest) to 1 (highest).

production_ready.title: Production Ready
production_ready.description: Indicates whether the technology is considered reliable and stable enough for production workloads.

maturity.title: Maturity
maturity.description: The current lifecycle and adoption maturity stage of the technology.

difficulty.title: Difficulty
difficulty.description: The assessed level of expertise required to successfully implement and maintain the technology.

best_for.title: Best For
best_for.description: Optimal scenarios, domains, or specific use cases where this technology excels.

avoid_for.title: Avoid For
avoid_for.description: Scenarios, architectures, or specific use cases where this technology should explicitly not be used.

strengths.title: Strengths
strengths.description: The primary technical and operational strengths of the technology.

weaknesses.title: Weaknesses
weaknesses.description: Known limitations, architectural flaws, or operational weaknesses of the technology.
examples: High memory consumption during index building
Steep learning curve for advanced configurations

tradeoffs.title: Tradeoffs
tradeoffs.description: Notable compromises or trade-offs inherent in adopting this technology (e.g., speed vs accuracy).
examples: Sacrifices absolute recall for lower query latency
Increases operational complexity for better horizontal scalability

prerequisites.title: Prerequisites
prerequisites.description: Technical, architectural, or skill-based requirements needed prior to adopting this technology.

reasoning.title: Reasoning
reasoning.description: Detailed justification and analytical reasoning behind the recommendation score and stance.
examples: Qdrant consistently delivers high throughput and low latency. Its Rust-based architecture ensures memory safety and high performance under load. While index building requires substantial memory, the query-time performance makes it a top-tier choice for production RAG systems.

alternatives.title: Alternatives
alternatives.description: Forge entity IDs of alternative or competing technologies that could fulfill a similar role.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Relevant keywords for search, filtering, and categorization of this recommendation.

last_evaluated.title: Last Evaluated
last_evaluated.description: Timestamp indicating when Forge experts last reviewed or updated this recommendation.

supporting_citations.title: Supporting Citations
supporting_citations.description: A required list of citations and references that support the provided evaluation and reasoning.
